title: Subgroups of a finite free abelian group are finite free
statement: Let $J$ be a finite set and $\mathbf Z^J$ the free abelian group of functions $J\to\mathbf Z$. Every subgroup $N\subseteq\mathbf Z^J$ is a free abelian group of finite rank $r\leq|J|$: there are $e_1,\ldots,e_r\in N$ such that every element of $N$ is $\sum_ia_ie_i$ for unique $a_1,\ldots,a_r\in\mathbf Z$. Consequently an abelian group isomorphic to a subgroup of $\mathbf Z^J$ is free of finite rank.
